description: The approval code and the collect signature of a takeover script (ADR 0038). Every value is fictitious; the private key is not part of the vector, so a signer tests its own signing with a key it makes and verifies it with its own verification. Octet strings are lower-case hexadecimal unless named base64url (RFC 4648 section 5, no padding).

code.rule: code = the first 80 bits of SHA-256(context || 0x00 || len(domain) || domain || root_sha256 || request_sha256 || key || approval_id_octets), written as 16 characters of the alphabet, most significant bits first, in four groups of four joined by hyphens
code.domain_rule: the plan's domain in canonical form: lower-case ASCII without a trailing dot, preceded by its length in one octet
code.root_rule: the SHA-256 of the DER of the self-signed root the script built its chain to by signature verification
code.request_rule: the exact octets of the POST /api/v1/auth/approvals body as sent (UTF-8), which carries the plan

typed.rule: a typed code is read without spaces and hyphens, in upper case, with O read as 0 and I and L as 1; it must then be 16 characters of the alphabet

collect.rule: signature = ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256 over context || 0x00 || approval_id_octets || nonce, as r || s of 32 octets each; the collect body is {"signature": base64url}
collect.signature_rule: ECDSA signatures are randomized: this one verifies with the key, another signature of the same message verifies too
